author: Syrian Observatory for Human Rights

content_variants.text:
After being arrested for a month | International Coalition releases civilian accused of belonging to IS-IS

Deir Ezzor province: The International Coalition forces released a young man after he was released for nearly a month by an airdrop operation by an SDF patrol supported by the International Coalition, where he was arrested from inside his house in Al-Shahil city in eastern Deir Ezzor countryside. He was released after being investigated and the charges were dropped.

On January 22, SOHR sources reported that three ISIS members were arrested in the operation that was carried out by counter-terrorism units with the support of the “International Coalition” aircraft in the early hours of Sunday morning, SOHR sources reported.

The units raided a number of houses of Al-Madad family in Al-Shuhayil in the eastern countryside of Deir Ezzor, and the operation lasted for two hours.

The attacking forces asked the wanted men to surrender via loudspeakers, but they refused, and then SDF and coalition forces raided the house and arrested three men.
